status: Re-checked all 6 items at Reuseit, TeknikFix and Inrego: prices and stock unchanged, no VMB note, and no new qualifying deals at Reuseit, TeknikFix or MacRent. Couldn't verify Inet (blocks automated loading) or the NetOnNet new reference, so those are kept as is.

items.why: **Cheapest overall.** 14" 16:10, ~1.13 kg. But "Okej skick" (visible wear) and an older 11th-gen chip

items.pick_text: Same chip as the X1 Carbon G10, A-grade, about 1,200 kr cheaper. Smaller 13.3" screen and ~150 g heavier.

items.why: **Best ThinkPad.** 14" 16:10, lightest (~1.12 kg), premium build, good condition
items.pick_text: The premium ThinkPad: 14" 16:10, ~1.12 kg, best keyboard. Beats every T14s and X13 G4 for less money.

items.why: **Cheapest Mac.** Still quick for writing and coding, but "Okej skick" (visible wear) and 6 years old, so battery wear is the risk
**Best value Mac.** Also the safest used Air: A-grade, battery guaranteed above 80%, 12-month warranty plus 6 months on the battery. Shop in Stockholm
items.pick_text: The only M2 Air left that fits: A-grade, battery guaranteed above 80%, 12-month warranty. Fanless, ~1.24 kg, Swedish keyboard.

items.why: **Best screen.** 120 Hz mini-LED, HDMI and SD slot, faster under sustained load. Heavier (~1.6 kg)

new_reference.note: Cheapest new M5 Air from a shop that sells to companies. Used only to show how much the used options save.

notes: Reuseit sells some items under the margin scheme (VMB) and marks them "Denna produkt säljs enligt vinstmarginalbeskattning". The listings above showed **no such note** and list prices as "inkl. moms". Ask Reuseit to confirm full moms on the invoice before ordering. TeknikFix itemises moms at checkout and shows ex-moms prices in business mode.
dropped: **MacBook Air 13" M1 16/512, Bra** (Reuseit, 5,599): sold out (2026-11-05); the Okej listing at 5,199 replaces it
**T14 G1 i7 512** (Inet, 4,792): same price as the X13 G3 i7, but older (10th gen), thicker and heavier
**X13 G3 i5 480** (Inrego, 5,799) and **X13 G3 i7 480** (Inrego, 7,599): Inet's X13 G3 i7 512 is cheaper than both
**T14s G2 i5/i7** (Inet), **T14s G3 i7** (Inrego, 6,399), **X13 G4** (Inrego, 6,799): the X1 Carbon G10 is lighter, has a better 14" screen, and costs less than or about the same as each
**X1 Yoga G8** (Inrego, 8,599): you'd be paying for touch and a 2-in-1 hinge you don't need
**Other Reuseit X1 Carbon G10s** (5,279–5,759 ex): "Okej" or "Bra" grade, or P-series chips (i7-1260P/1270P) that run hotter and drain the battery faster
**Reuseit L14 G3 64 GB / 1 TB** (7,999 ex): heavy budget model. **P15v / P15s**: 15" workstations, too heavy
**MacBook Air 13" M5, new** (~13,592 ex at NetOnNet): you prefer used, and a used M2 Air does nearly everything it does for about half the price
**MacBook Air 15" M5**: new, and more than the MBP 14
**MacBook Pro 14" M1 Pro 32 GB / 1 TB** (Reuseit, ~9,599 ex, Okej): heavier, older battery, shorter macOS support than the M2 Air; 32 GB is more than you need
**MacBook Pro 14" M2 Pro at TeknikFix** (14,392, B-grade): the same machine is 2,150 kr cheaper at Inrego
**MacBook Pro 16"** M2 Pro / M2 Max: too big and heavy to travel with (2.1 kg)
**MacRent** used Macs: M1 Air with only 256 GB, MBP 13" with 8 GB RAM, and Pros from 16,800. Nothing beats the list
**Used M4 Air**: none with 512 GB at a seller that invoices with moms. Refurbished M4s cost more than a new M5
**Anything with 240/256 GB**: too small for Windows plus dev tools

changes.text: Reuseit M2 Air (7,599 ex) and M1 Air Bra (5,599 ex) sold out. Cheapest Mac is now the Reuseit M1 Air, Okej grade, 5,199 ex. Best value Mac is now the TeknikFix M2 Air at 10,392 ex.
Shortlist moved to laptops.json so a daily routine can update it.
